description: 1900-2018 : SERVICE ASSAINISSEMENT is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes du Pays Fertois. all reports and budgets of the sanitation service. Coverage: Communauté de Communes du Pays Fertois. The portal shows the English title as "1900-2018 : ASSAINMENT SERVICE" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes du Pays Fertois. Its keywords include assainissement-collectif, assainissement-non-collectif, communaute-de-communes-du-pays-fertois, ccpf. The listing shows 6 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2020-12-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
